title: The browser shows a batch 429 busy answer as the daily limit
evidence: api.lab-import-v2.ts sends code daily_limit or busy beside the words on every 429; widget-src/src/lib/upload-api.ts tooMany reads it once as a closed set (missing or unknown is rate_limit); busy is errorCode busy, counted as serverError with the notice "Not read. Our server was busy. Please try again later." and Sentry tag uploadErrorCode busy. Same lead as H62 on PR 1442 (unmerged). US-12 AC9, AC10.
